# FDG8101

> DO NOT throw exceptions from equality operators.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.13 Equality Operators.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1065
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

CA1065 reports an exception created directly in operator == or operator != (probe with SDK 10.0.402). Exceptions from methods the operator calls, such as a NullReferenceException from a null argument, are not seen, so coverage is partial. CA1065 has no code fix.

## From the book

For example, return false if one of the arguments is null instead of throwing `NullReferenceException`.
